test_perceptionlm_model: run the PerceptionLMForConditionalGenerationModelTest suite to verify model forward pass and training behavior
test_integration_image_generation: run the integration test that generates text descriptions from images using PerceptionLM
test_integration_batched_generation: run the batched integration test that processes both image and video conversations with PerceptionLM
test_mismatching_image_tokens: test that PerceptionLM raises a ValueError when image features and image tokens do not match
test_generation_no_images: test that PerceptionLM can generate text from text-only inputs without any images
